text: I booked a nose surgery appointment through a large online page and paid a deposit. I trusted the admin because they seemed friendly and helpful. However, when the Phuket branch called – after speaking with them 3-4 times – they were incredibly sarcastic and rude. They didn't seem to care about the customer at all. I knew the surgery couldn't be postponed, but I had an urgent matter that required immediate attention. I couldn't just have the surgery and wait. I asked if I could increase my deposit or switch to a smaller procedure like filler or Botox, and tried to discuss the possibility, but the staff were unresponsive, unwilling to try and retain the customer, and completely uninterested. I'm glad I didn't go with them because I would have been very disappointed by their terrible service and lack of customer care.

text: It's been over two weeks since I had my nose revision surgery. The actual price wasn't the same as what was advertised on the page. The price was one thing during the appointment and another on the day of the procedure. The day before the surgery, the staff said that if I wanted a beautiful, one-time procedure, I had to pay a different price for a "Barbie" shape. The page advertised a revision + augmentation package for 13,888 baht, but they tried to push the price down to 20,000-30,000 baht or more. They were trying to scare me about the initial price. However, I told the doctor I didn't want the Barbie shape; I just wanted my original shape, just to prevent it from being crooked. They accommodated my request, but I didn't ask for a refund for not wanting the Barbie shape. The staff just stayed silent, only saying it was some kind of silicone, which I don't remember the name of. Now I'm waiting to see if it will look good after the swelling subsides.
